answer: Every fake agent still traces back to some operator, so tie pay to operators, not accounts. The operator taps a passport's chip, whose state signature proves it genuine, and posts a zero-knowledge proof that reveals only a nullifier: a one-way cipher of the document number scoped to this network, so the same passport always yields the same tag. One tag, one paid identity; extra agents may wander and work but share that one reward. A farm needs a real passport per fake, and buying them is slow, risky and traceable, a basalt floor no script drills through.
